app_fee.value: Central research guidance outlines tuition fees and postgraduate funding without stating a general application fee for research degree programmes.

fee_waiver.value: Central guidance does not publish fee waiver procedures as no general PGR application fee is stated.

gre_general.value: GRE General test is not required or requested centrally for postgraduate research admission at Newcastle.

toefl_min.value: Standard minimum English requirement for degree programmes is TOEFL iBT 90 with minimum sub-scores (such as reading 18).
toefl_min.quote:

ielts_min.value: Standard minimum English requirement is IELTS 6.5 overall with at least 5.5 in each of the four sub-skills.
ielts_min.quote: In most cases you will need an overall score of IELTS 6.5 or equivalent. You will also need at least IELTS 5.5 or equivalent in each of the four sub-ski

english_waiver.value: Exemption applies only to applicants from approved majority English-speaking countries; degrees from non-majority countries like India do not waive the test requirement.
english_waiver.quote: If English is not your first language you will need to provide a recognised English language test or qualification.

notes: Postgraduate research degrees at Newcastle University include PhD, MPhil, and MD programmes across faculties.
